name: Sesame-Ginger Glazed Salmon with Avocado-Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: In a shallow bowl, whisk together the minced garlic and ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil.
Place the salmon flesh side down in the marinade and coat both sides; let it sit while you prepare the salad dressing.
In a large bowl, prepare the salad dressing by whisking together the mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
rice vinegar
toasted sesame oil
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the sesame seeds to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl.

Once sesame seeds have been removed, increase heat to medium-high. Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Place salmon in the skillet skin-side down, reserving marinade in the bowl. Cook until skin is crisp, 3-4 minutes, then flip over and pour the reserved marinade over top. Continue cooking salmon in the marinade until opaque, 3-4 more minutes.

instructions.secondary_message:
3 English cucumbers
3 avocados
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Halve the cucumbers crosswise, then quarter lengthwise and slice crosswise on an angle; add to the bowl with dressing. Halve and pit the avocados; scoop out the flesh with a spoon and medium dice; add to the bowl. Trim onion ends and thinly chop on an angle; add to the bowl. Gently toss until well combined.
To serve, place salmon on a plate and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
